acs.text: WHEN a signed-in user calls `POST /api/v1/rooms/{roomId}/members` for an existing room THE SYSTEM SHALL make them a `member` if they are not one and respond 200 with the room and their role; calling it again changes nothing and answers the same; the owner gets the room with role `owner`; a room that does not exist gets 404 `room.not_found`.

WHEN a member who is not the owner calls `DELETE /api/v1/rooms/{roomId}/members/me` THE SYSTEM SHALL remove their membership and respond 204; the owner gets 403 `room.owner_cannot_leave`; a non-member gets 404 `room.not_found`.

scenarios: Status from the relay, or a quiet fallback

acs.text: WHEN the account-deletion webhook deletes a user THE SYSTEM SHALL, after the deletion has committed, ask the relay to drop that user from every room they were a member of; a relay failure is logged (`relay_drop_failed`) and does not undo the deletion or fail the webhook.

WHEN a request carries an `Origin` listed in `SOCIAL_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer its CORS preflight with 204 (no token needed) and add `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` with that origin to every API response; a request from any other origin gets no CORS headers.
scenarios: Browsers on the reader's origin may call the API

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in viewer opens the lobby of a room they are not a member of THE SYSTEM SHALL show a Join button; pressing it joins and then shows the room's title; a signed-out viewer pressing Join gets `host.viewer.requestSignIn()` (R17) and no API call; a room that does not exist shows the room-not-found message.
